_about: Inventory of Niagaros critical enterprise flows (issue #279). 'exists' says whether the product feature exists today. A flow is COVERED only when at least one automated test in this repo is tagged with its id. Flows for features that do not exist are kept in the inventory as honest gaps, never tested with fake stand-ins. 'owner' is the responsible team role (proposed; no per-person ownership is recorded anywhere yet).

flows.name: Authentication gate: missing/invalid/forged tokens are rejected
Sign in -> session -> refresh -> sign out (revoked token is rejected); wrong password and unknown user are indistinguishable
Sign up -> verify identity (email code) -> MFA (TOTP) -> session
flows.gap_reason: Verification codes are delivered by email and MFA needs a TOTP secret enrolled per user; both need a mailbox the tests can read and AWS admin credentials in CI. MFA is OPTIONAL in the user pool today.

flows.name: Tenant isolation / authorization: users only reach their own account's data
Injection / XSS regression protection in the frontend
Platform availability: independent status endpoint + public status page
Connect AWS -> validate permissions -> discover resources -> scan -> create findings -> display
flows.gap_reason: The scan needs a real AWS role to assume and its results are only readable by the account's owner. The test tenants use placeholder AWS account ids, and a real customer account (Domits) is deliberately never accessed by tests; a dedicated scannable AWS test account is needed.

flows.name: Finding lifecycle: detected -> owner assigned -> remediation executed -> retested -> resolved
flows.gap_reason: Product gap: findings are detected and tracked (first_detected_at) but there is no owner-assignment or remediation-execution workflow to test yet.

flows.name: Compliance: custom frameworks, controls and calculators work end to end
Framework mappers: every control maps to real checks or is honestly manual
Audit created -> listed -> validated -> removed
Vendor created -> listed -> updated -> deleted
Recipient added -> scoped -> failure of an external integration reported -> removed; preferences round-trip; analytics consistent
Delivery routing: each channel reaches the right sender; failures are reported, never thrown
AI agent: intent classification is hardened against malformed/invented model output
Questionnaire uploaded -> stored -> renamed -> deleted; public share link handles bad tokens
Questionnaire parsing, evidence confidence and upload validation
Trust Center admin view and public page behave correctly
Notification Settings: tabs, add-person wizard, validation, test buttons, save
Every shipped page loads without script errors
Deployed pages work end to end with a real session against the enforcing API (no mocks)
API error handling: validation, malformed input, CORS, no leaked internals
Test data hygiene: nothing created by tests is left behind
Account onboarding: tied to a verified identity, validated, idempotent
Create enterprise -> business units -> invite team -> assign roles -> connect infra -> onboarding complete
flows.gap_reason: Product gap: Niagaros has no enterprise / business-unit / team-invitation model today (accounts are single-owner). Nothing exists to test.

flows.name: Jira / Monday: connect -> map project -> create ticket -> synchronize status
flows.gap_reason: Product gap: there is no Jira or Monday integration (the AI agent even lists them as unsupported). Only a GitHub integration exists.
